requirementSummary: Autopopulate the Unit Type dropdown based on selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant, then autopopulate the Unit Size dropdown based on selected Refrigerant and Unit Type.
businessRules: When a user selects a Condenser Type and a Refrigerant, the Unit Type dropdown must be filtered to options whose 'parent' includes the selected Refrigerant (and implicitly the selected Condenser Type).
When a user selects a Unit Type, the Unit Size dropdown must be filtered to options whose 'parent' includes both the selected Refrigerant and the selected Unit Type.
Only items with "isActive": true should be presented in the dropdowns.
developerConsiderations: Retrieve dropdown data via the unitdesign API endpoint GET /dropdowns.
Use the SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant attribute to obtain Unit Type options and filter on its 'parent' array.
Use the SDCommonUnitModelSizes attribute to obtain Unit Size options and filter on its 'parent' array containing both Refrigerant and Unit Type.
Implement UI logic to trigger filtering after each relevant selection change and to clear dependent dropdowns when upstream selections change.
Ensure asynchronous calls handle loading states and error handling.
Confirm that Condenser Type data is available for filtering Unit Type; if not, coordinate with backend to include it.
Respect the 'isActive' flag to exclude inactive entries.
ambiguities: How the selected Condenser Type influences the Unit Type filter, since the provided data example only shows Refrigerant in the 'parent' field.
Behavior when no matching Unit Type or Unit Size entries exist (e.g., display message, disable dropdown).
Whether filtering should be case‑sensitive or case‑insensitive.
If selections should be persisted or reset when the user changes a previous dropdown.
